title: Ring-sheaf map induced by a constant coefficient homomorphism
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme and $\varphi:A\to B$ a unital homomorphism of commutative rings. Use the constant-ring presentation of small pro-etale modules in [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations] and the constant sheaf functor of [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Define $\varphi_T:A_T\to B_T$ as that constant sheaf functor applied to $\operatorname{ULift}(\varphi)$, using the fixed coefficient universe lift. Thus its action on constant sections is $a\mapsto\varphi(a)$; the coefficient objects, sheafifications and scalar actions are unchanged.
